event_summary: A rotating tan stick on a black round device contacts a row of upright colored blocks, after which the blocks tip leftward and come to rest lying or leaning on the tabletop.
raw_event_description: At the start, six colored rectangular blocks stand upright in a row on a wooden tabletop, with a black circular object to their right and a tan pointed stick extending from its top area. The stick visibly changes orientation while protruding from the black object. It approaches and then contacts the rightmost purple block. The purple block tips left, followed in order by the blue, green, pink, red-orange, and yellow blocks. The blocks settle in a leftward-collapsed arrangement on the tabletop while the black circular object remains in place and the stick remains extended from it.

reasons: All six colored blocks are visible standing upright before the visible collapse.
The black circular object and protruding tan stick are visible to the right of the blocks.
The tabletop and background are unobstructed.
